The independent documentation reviewer inspected all eight shipped and self-hosted files, checked every targeted link/heading route and confirmed the coordinator's intent checkpoint. The separate builder exercised ordinary inputs, a live listener, five injected failures, a later successful response and a broken counter-only variant; QA identified the same-server response as decisive. The generator's valid-response failures and accepted empty list justified rejecting this decoder/version/endpoint; swapped-tag rejections were inconclusive. Worker-only measurements justified retaining the runtime pending attribution; the hypothetical matched trial named workload, OS, CPU/tail latency and lifecycle checks. No new lane or technology dependency. Limits: worked examples and documentation coverage; no Tensorwell rerun or downstream adoption observed.
